if: the document is a payment voucher referred to in clause (g) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 52 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the payment voucher MUST carry the supplier's name, address and GSTIN if the supplier is registered
note: One mandatory particular of rule 52(a), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number of the supplier if registered;
evidence.extraction_note: Rule 52(a) is the only one of these particulars qualified by 'if registered' for the SUPPLIER: a payment voucher is issued by the recipient paying tax under reverse charge, so the supplier may be unregistered.
